// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.54

|gr1= Variables

|gr2= Arrays

|descr= Compares types of all elements of an array to the type of a single value. Since Arma 3 v2.09.149634 no additional check is needed to make sure the first argument is an [[Array]].
{{Feature|important|An empty array will return {{hl|[[false]]}} (see {{Link|#Example 2}}).}}

|s1= arr [[isEqualTypeAll]] val

|p1= arr: [[Anything]] - (was [[Array]] before {{GVI|arma3|2.10|size= 0.75}})

|p2= val: [[Anything]]

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>
_arr = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,0];
_arr isEqualTypeAll ""; // false
_arr isEqualTypeAll 0;	// true
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
[] isEqualTypeAll "";	// false
[""] isEqualTypeAll "";	// true
</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>
0 isEqualTypeAll "";	// false
0 isEqualTypeAll 0;		// false
[0] isEqualTypeAll 0;	// true
</sqf>

|seealso= [[isEqualTypeArray]] [[isEqualTypeAny]] [[isEqualType]] [[isEqualTypeParams]] [[param]] [[params]] [[isEqualTo]] [[typeName]]
}}
